verdict.rule: three facts are decided separately, each on the random-window protocol with the paired case-cluster interval against lambda = 0 at the same seed: RECALL (L6 recall on the evidence spines rises with the interval excluding zero on at least two of three seeds), FILM (no film source's interval excludes zero against the loss on two seeds), COST (the false-L6 rate rises with the interval excluding zero on two seeds). HELPS = recall up, film held, no cost shown; TRADE-OFF = recall up, film held, cost shown; HURTS = a film source degrades or recall falls; otherwise NOT SHOWN

lambda=1.0.call: TRADE-OFF: L6 recall up, film held, false-L6 up
